messages:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up: policy update — training completion verification is now required before managers submit calibration packets for Q4 reviews. See handbook note and manager checklist: https://redwood.internal/handbook/perf-training-cert. Please certify your team's compliance by Nov 8.

Ivy (HR Ops): Clarify: does certification mean managers must confirm every team member completed required modules, or just those in data-access roles?

Sam (People Ops): All headcount included in the review packet must be certified. For roles without data access, a shorter acknowledgement (handbook attest) suffices; for data roles, full LMS completion required.

Derek (Engineering Manager): We run calibration a week earlier in EMEA due to local holidays. Any deadline flexibility?

Sam (People Ops): Yes — managers in EMEA can request a date shift via HR ticket; we'll accept shifts up to 7 days earlier. Log requests for audit.

Ana (Legal): Audit requirement: exports must include manager certification (manager id, timestamp), list of employees in the packet, training module ids and completion timestamps. People Ops, please store exports in compliance S3 with two-year retention.

Onboarding Bot: automated: Reminder: new hires assigned "Handbook Essentials" on day 1. Managers must include onboarding status in calibration packets.

LMS Bot: automated: Progress snapshot: 384 staff have modules due; 210 completed. Link to report: https://lms.redwood.internal/reports/q4-cert.

Derek (Engineering Manager): Will managers get a consolidated CSV for their packet list? That will help.

Ivy (HR Ops): Yes — created manager CSV export: https://sheets.redwood.internal/q4-calibration-cert. CSV header to paste:

manager,employee_email,employee_id,packet_included,training_status,completed_at,certified_at,notes

Sam (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll do a follow-up on Nov 3 with a reminder and run the audit export after the certification window closes. Ping me if you need bulk exemptions recorded. :thumbsup:
